summary_zh: 前文两人争论“同一部手机”绕过尼日利亚进口商直销，省下加价是否会带来宏观代价。收录帖把话题具体到 样例竞品 的运输、手续费和本地派送收益。后续称厂家在 Yaba 按供货价卖会淘汰价值链；对方反驳 样例竞品 免运且更便宜，并以 Apple 直营类比。上下文显示这是经济观点争辩，非具体消费投诉。

posts.text: We are about to learn SS2 economics together 😀

posts.text: @SheunAdeola It’s the truth brother. It the same phone. Simple

posts.text: @Sweeegu Sure. You’d get a cheaper phone for now. But it will come at a steeper price down the line

posts.translation_zh: @Sweeegu 当然。你现在会买到更便宜的手机。但以后会付出更沉重的代价

posts.text:
Bro??? It’s literally the same phone weve been getting, i don’t understand this assertion. It’s the same phone from the same place, now sold directly? 

So because I am now not paying 2k to a Nigerian importer I should now be worried? It is THE SAME PHONE (product)

So if Apple opens Apple stores here and start selling the iPhone 18 at the global price, we should ignore them and pay vendors the extra markup?

兄弟？？？这明明就是我们一直在买的同一部手机，我不理解这种说法。它是来自同一个地方的同一部手机，现在只是直接销售了？

所以因为我现在不用给尼日利亚进口商付 2k，我就应该担心了吗？这是同一部手机（产品）

所以如果 Apple 在这里开 Apple Store，并开始按全球价格销售 iPhone 18，我们就应该无视它们，转而给卖家支付额外加价吗？

posts.text:

@Sweeegu 只是这里发生的并不是那样。如果你从 Temu 购买，你承担运输和手续费。你为此付费。尼日利亚经济中唯一赚钱的部分，是把东西送到你手上的配送服务。

这里的问题是，那些为 Temu 生产的公司……续

posts.text:
@Sweeegu …are now selling in Yaba at the prices they sell to Temu. Which means Temu is getting wiped out.

Now imagine Temu was making all that money and keeping it in Nigeria. Thousands of jobs in value chain will be wiped overnight, GDP contribution disappears, household income shrinks
posts.original_text:

posts.translation_zh:
@Sweeegu ……现在正在 Yaba 以他们卖给 Temu 的价格出售。这意味着 Temu 正在被淘汰。

现在想象一下，如果 Temu 赚了所有那些钱，并把钱留在尼日利亚。价值链中的数千个工作岗位会在一夜之间消失，GDP 贡献会消失，家庭收入会缩水

posts.text:
I just bought stuff from Temu, the shipping was free but thats by the way. Even if I paid for it, the cost of the shipping and product is cheaper than what vendors were charging because they were doing the same thing and adding their margins 

If Apple, iPhone maker, brings an Apple Store to Lagos and they sell the nee iPhone 18, should the vendors protest their entry into the market because they have been buying iPhones and importing them to sell at a markup?
posts.original_text:
I just bought stuff from Temu, the shipping was free but thats by the way. Even if I paid for it, the cost of the shipping and product is cheaper than what vendors were charging because they were doing the same thing and adding their margins

posts.translation_zh:
我刚从 Temu 买了东西，运费是免费的，不过这不是重点。即使我付了运费，运费加商品的成本也比商家收的价格更便宜，因为他们做的是同样的事，然后再加上自己的利润率。

如果 Apple，也就是 iPhone 制造商，在 Lagos 开一家 Apple Store，并销售新款 iPhone 18，商家是否应该抗议他们进入市场，因为他们一直在购买 iPhone 并进口后加价出售？
